Spray Dried Mango Alphonso Powder: The Taste of India's Favourite Mango

Alphonso is India's most famous mango variety, known for its rich aroma, deep golden colour and creamy sweetness. Tradenest Naturals offers spray dried mango alphonso powder for beverage, confectionery, dairy and bakery manufacturers. We use Alphonso mangoes carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Spray drying turns the fruit pulp into a fine, free-flowing powder that keeps much of its natural colour and flavour. It is a convenient way to bring a true Alphonso taste into products that are made all year round.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Mango Alphonso Powder?

As a spray dried mango alphonso powder supplier, we know that flavour consistency is what our buyers care about most. Our process is built to protect the aromatic notes that make Alphonso special, so your finished products carry that familiar profile. The powder also dissolves well in water and milk. That makes it easy to handle on production lines and helps give a smooth texture in drinks and desserts. If you are looking for a dependable bulk spray dried mango alphonso powder supplier india, Tradenest Naturals can grow with you. We serve small confectionery makers as well as larger food companies. As a spray dried mango alphonso powder exporter, we also provide export documentation support for smooth international shipping. We are an FSSAI registered food business and IEC registered exporter.

How the Powder Is Made

Production starts with ripe, good-quality Alphonso mangoes. First, the fruit is washed, peeled and pulped. Next, the pulp is fed into a spray dryer, where fine droplets meet warm air and the moisture evaporates within seconds. This fast drying helps keep the natural colour and aroma of the fruit. Finally, the powder is sieved to a uniform 80-100 mesh, which suits automated dosing and blending equipment. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Technical Specifications and Quality

We believe in clear technical data. Our wholesale spray dried mango alphonso powder is produced to a fixed set of parameters. Moisture is kept low to prevent caking and to support shelf life. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Below are the standard specifications:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for good dispersion.
  • Moisture Content: < 5% for stability.
  • Processing: Spray dried from Alphonso mango pulp.
  • Solubility: Dissolves readily in water and liquid bases.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Because of its rich, recognisable flavour, our mango powder is used across many sectors:
  • Beverage Industry: Instant mango drinks, smoothies, lassi premixes and flavoured waters.
  • Confectionery: Mango gummies, hard candies and chocolate fillings.
  • Dairy & Ice Cream: Natural mango flavour and colour in yogurts, milkshakes and ice creams.
  • Bakery: Muffins, cakes, cookies and pastry creams.
  • Nutraceuticals: A natural fruit flavour base for drink powders and chewables.
